ns2:course.label: Special Topics
ns2:course.description: Lecture courses in topics of current interest; specific subject matter will be announced in the Class Schedule. 1 to 4 undergraduate hours. 1 to 4 graduate hours. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated up to 12 hours if topics vary. Prerequisite: See Class Schedule for section requirements.
